scope: M2-B continuous replay account and learning branches; not full online/replay convergence, scheduler isolation or M3

targeted.command: uv run pytest tests/test_walk_branch.py tests/test_walk_forward.py tests/test_review.py tests/test_decision_frames.py tests/test_decision_lab.py tests/test_trader_lifecycle_m1.py tests/test_t1_decider.py -q --no-header

full_suite.warning_detail: Existing test_build_lock multi-threaded multiprocessing fork deprecation warnings

source_verification.method: Compared every tested-files archive member to verified-files.json using SHA-256 and Git blob SHA, then matched the successful runner git ls-tree manifest
source_verification.plan_handling: Tested active plan replaced by completed delivery record; verification JSON added separately

important_semantics.checkpoint: Runner-owned successful end-of-session boundary; fresh prefix state required, not an arbitrary old run directory
important_semantics.state: All memory.db tables, trader histories, local indexes/variants and carried review/exposure/pending state; not a full live process image
important_semantics.sqlite: Committed WAL included through backup API; quiescent source required, no distributed multi-database snapshot guarantee
important_semantics.initial_account: Cash, invested and marked value, realized/unrealized profit, equity and position/order counts reconciled before the first continuation decision
important_semantics.lineage: Parent observations retain their identity and remain visible to measured learning through explicit parent/child scope; unrelated runs excluded
important_semantics.intervention: One exact unique knowledge replacement in the first open trade plan of the first continuation day; not permanent rule removal or update-algorithm intervention
important_semantics.independence: Private writable branch copies, fresh process/run ID/model journal; parent future model replies not copied or replayed
important_semantics.limits: 16 branches, 30 sessions each, 200 declared branch-sessions, two concurrent branches and explicit deadline; not a monetary cost cap
important_semantics.failure: Failed/incomplete branches retained, missing model-backed close reviews counted as lost learning, no retry-until-profit or tape splicing
important_semantics.usage: Agent-journal counts are not total provider billing; interrupted requests and other model clients can be unobserved
important_semantics.validation: Real runner equivalence uses synthetic market fixtures; independent review/handbook learning uses deterministic stub responses, not a real model

not_verified: User's original seven historical runs or historical journal import
Real-model effectiveness, behavioral improvement or profitability
Full live-process restoration, broker integration or minute-level executable paths
Point-in-time truth of historical market inputs, model training knowledge or provider-side routing
Full online/replay strategy convergence or scheduler/control-plane isolation
M3 end-to-end behavioral evolution, independent forward improvement or promotion
